title: Salaar Part 1: Ceasefire
desc: Just when the prince of Khansaar is about to rise to the throne, a plan of overthrowing him is exercised and only one man can help him retrieve power.

title: Shravana Banthu
desc: Kailash and Urvashi's relationship remains unfulfilled due to a tragedy in their past lives. Years later, Kailash's friend Vishwas tries to reunite the lovers in their present births.

title: Solillada Saradara
desc: Krishna, a ferry driver, is about to marry Rukmini, the love of his life. However, things take a turn when a landlord's daughter falls for him.

title: Namma Basava
desc: A bountiful and helpful boy falls in love with a musician without knowing the fact that a rich spoilt brat is also planning to woo her.
